meta.caption: Definition of enumerators of Health Channels

versions.content:
[SWS_PHM_01119]
⌈
For each PhmHealthChannelStatus contained in the PhmHealthChannelIn-
terface, there shall exist the corresponding enumeration nested in the declaration
defined by [SWS_PHM_01118] as:
<enumeratorLiteral> = <initializer><suffix>,
where:
<enumeratorLiteral> is PhmHealthChannelStatus.shortName
<initializer> is the PhmHealthChannelStatus.statusId
<suffix> shall be "U".
⌋
